Cliopatria's Iberian Union row (1582-1639) is the whole European Spanish Habsburg monarchy; the Iberian Union dossier runs 25 Aug 1580 to 1 Dec 1640 and adds keyframes 1580, 1581-1582 and 1640 (successors' own shapes should win in 1640).
